"""Tests for the delegation eligibility gate module."""

from subject import (
    is_delegation_eligible,
    MAX_DELEGATION_FILES,
    MAX_DELEGATION_LINES,
    TWO_STRIKE_THRESHOLD,
)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_eligible_basic_case():
    """A simple, small, clean diff should be eligible."""
    eligible, reason = is_delegation_eligible(
        block_reason="code_failure",
        changed_files=["src/app.py"],
        diff_total_lines=10,
        strikes=0,
    )
    assert eligible is True
    assert reason == "eligible"


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_eligible_changes_requested():
    """changes_requested is also an eligible block reason."""
    eligible, reason = is_delegation_eligible(
        block_reason="changes_requested",
        changed_files=["src/utils.py"],
        diff_total_lines=5,
        strikes=0,
    )
    assert eligible is True
    assert reason == "eligible"

def test_ineligible_unknown_block_reason():

        block_reason="receipt_failure",

        diff_total_lines=10,
        strikes=0,
